title: Ordering Food at a Ramen Shop
description: A customer orders ramen and tea at a small ramen restaurant.

lines.targetText: いらっしゃいませ。何名様ですか。
lines.englishTranslation: Welcome. How many people?

vocabularyItems.explanation: A common greeting used by staff.
Polite way to ask the number of guests.

lines.targetText: 一人です。
lines.englishTranslation: Just one person.

lines.targetText: こちらの席へどうぞ。
lines.englishTranslation: Please take this seat.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Polite way to refer to a direction or place.

lines.targetText: 味噌ラーメンをお願いします。
lines.englishTranslation: Miso ramen, please.

vocabularyItems.explanation: A ramen dish with miso broth.
Marks the object of the sentence.
Polite phrase used when making requests.

lines.targetText: 飲み物はいかがですか。
lines.englishTranslation: Would you like a drink?

title: Asking for Directions to the Station
description: A tourist asks a local person how to get to the nearest train station.

lines.targetText: すみません、駅はどこですか。
lines.pronunciationGuide: sumimasen, eki wa doko desu ka.
lines.englishTranslation: Excuse me, where is the station?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Used to politely get someone's attention.
Usually refers to a train station.

lines.targetText: 駅はこの道をまっすぐです。
lines.pronunciationGuide: eki wa kono michi o massugu desu.
lines.englishTranslation: The station is straight down this road.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Used before a noun near the speaker.

lines.targetText: ここから歩いて何分ぐらいですか。
lines.pronunciationGuide: koko kara aruite nanpun gurai desu ka.
lines.englishTranslation: About how many minutes is it on foot from here?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Te-form of walk; means by walking.

lines.targetText: 五分ぐらいです。近いですよ。
lines.pronunciationGuide: gofun gurai desu. chikai desu yo.
lines.englishTranslation: About five minutes. It's close.

lines.targetText: ありがとうございます。助かります。
lines.englishTranslation: Thank you very much. That helps.

vocabularyItems.expression: ありがとうございます

vocabularyItems.explanation: Used to say something is helpful.

title: Checking Into a Hotel
description: A traveler checks into a hotel and asks about breakfast.

lines.targetText: こんばんは。予約があります。
lines.englishTranslation: Good evening. I have a reservation.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Polite form of aru, used for things.

lines.targetText: お名前をお願いします。
lines.englishTranslation: May I have your name, please?

lines.targetText: 田中です。今日から二泊です。
lines.pronunciationGuide: Tanaka desu. kyou kara nihaku desu.
lines.englishTranslation: I'm Tanaka. I'm staying two nights from today.

lines.targetText: はい、こちらがカードキーです。
lines.pronunciationGuide: hai, kochira ga kaado kii desu.
lines.englishTranslation: Yes, this is your key card.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Polite way to refer to something nearby.

lines.targetText: 朝ご飯は何時からですか。
lines.pronunciationGuide: asagohan wa nanji kara desu ka.
lines.englishTranslation: What time does breakfast start?

title: Buying Snacks at a Convenience Store
description: A customer buys snacks and a drink at a convenience store.

lines.targetText: いらっしゃいませ。
lines.englishTranslation: Welcome.

lines.targetText: これとお茶をお願いします。
lines.englishTranslation: This and tea, please.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Refers to something near the speaker.

lines.targetText: 袋は必要ですか。
lines.englishTranslation: Do you need a bag?

lines.targetText: 大丈夫です。いりません。
lines.englishTranslation: It's okay. I don't need one.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Polite negative of iru, to need.

lines.targetText: 全部で五百円です。
lines.englishTranslation: That will be 500 yen in total.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Used when giving the total amount.

title: Small Talk With a Friend
description: Two friends talk about the weather and weekend plans.

lines.targetText: 今日はいい天気ですね。
lines.pronunciationGuide: kyou wa ii tenki desu ne.
lines.englishTranslation: The weather is nice today, isn't it?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Common adjective meaning good or nice.

lines.targetText: 本当ですね。外に行きたいです。
lines.pronunciationGuide: hontou desu ne. soto ni ikitai desu.
lines.englishTranslation: It really is. I want to go outside.

lines.targetText: 明日、時間がありますか。
lines.englishTranslation: Do you have time tomorrow?

lines.targetText: 午後なら大丈夫です。
lines.englishTranslation: Afternoon is fine.

lines.targetText: じゃあ、公園で会いましょう。
lines.englishTranslation: Then let's meet at the park.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Polite volitional form of au, to meet.

title: Meeting a New Classmate
description: Two students introduce themselves before class.

lines.targetText: はじめまして。私はユキです。
lines.englishTranslation: Nice to meet you. I'm Yuki.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Set phrase used when meeting someone for the first time.

lines.targetText: はじめまして。ケンです。
lines.englishTranslation: Nice to meet you. I'm Ken.

vocabularyItems.explanation: A given name written in katakana here.

lines.targetText: このクラスは初めてですか。
lines.pronunciationGuide: kono kurasu wa hajimete desu ka.
lines.englishTranslation: Is this your first time in this class?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Used before a noun near the speaker.
Used for doing something for the first time.

lines.targetText: はい、少し緊張しています。
lines.englishTranslation: Yes, I'm a little nervous.

lines.targetText: 大丈夫ですよ。先生は優しいです。
lines.pronunciationGuide: daijoubu desu yo. sensei wa yasashii desu.
lines.englishTranslation: It's okay. The teacher is kind.

title: Ordering Coffee at a Cafe
description: A customer orders coffee and cake at a cafe.

lines.targetText: ご注文はお決まりですか。
lines.englishTranslation: Are you ready to order?

lines.targetText: ホットコーヒーを一つください。
lines.englishTranslation: One hot coffee, please.

lines.targetText: ケーキもいかがですか。
lines.englishTranslation: Would you also like cake?

lines.targetText: そうですね。チーズケーキもお願いします。
lines.pronunciationGuide: sou desu ne. chiizu keeki mo onegaishimasu.
lines.englishTranslation: Let me see. Cheesecake too, please.

lines.targetText: 店内で召し上がりますか。
lines.englishTranslation: Will you have it here?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Used for eating or drinking in.
Very polite form of eat or drink.

title: Shopping for Clothes
description: A customer looks for a jacket in a clothing store.

lines.targetText: すみません、この上着はいくらですか。
lines.pronunciationGuide: sumimasen, kono uwagi wa ikura desu ka.
lines.englishTranslation: Excuse me, how much is this jacket?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Used before a noun near the speaker.

lines.targetText: それは三千円です。
lines.englishTranslation: That is 3,000 yen.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Refers to something near the listener.

lines.targetText: 黒はありますか。
lines.englishTranslation: Do you have it in black?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Marks the requested color as topic.

lines.targetText: はい、少し待ってください。
lines.englishTranslation: Yes, please wait a moment.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Polite request using te-form plus kudasai.

lines.targetText: 試着してもいいですか。
lines.pronunciationGuide: shichaku shite mo ii desu ka.
lines.englishTranslation: May I try it on?

title: At the Pharmacy
description: A traveler asks for cold medicine at a pharmacy.

lines.targetText: すみません、風邪薬はありますか。
lines.englishTranslation: Excuse me, do you have cold medicine?

lines.targetText: はい、あります。熱はありますか。
lines.pronunciationGuide: hai, arimasu. netsu wa arimasu ka.
lines.englishTranslation: Yes, we do. Do you have a fever?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Polite question asking if a symptom exists.

lines.targetText: いいえ、のどが痛いです。
lines.englishTranslation: No, my throat hurts.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Marks the body part with the symptom.

lines.targetText: では、この薬を一日三回飲んでください。
lines.pronunciationGuide: dewa, kono kusuri o ichinichi sankai nonde kudasai.
lines.englishTranslation: Then please take this medicine three times a day.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Used before a noun near the speaker.

lines.targetText: ありがとうございます。
lines.englishTranslation: Thank you very much.

vocabularyItems.expression: ありがとうございます

title: Buying a Train Ticket
description: A traveler asks about buying a train ticket.

lines.targetText: すみません、東京までの切符を買いたいです。
lines.pronunciationGuide: sumimasen, Toukyou made no kippu o kaitai desu.
lines.englishTranslation: Excuse me, I want to buy a ticket to Tokyo.

lines.targetText: 普通電車でいいですか。
lines.pronunciationGuide: futsuu densha de ii desu ka.
lines.englishTranslation: Is a local train okay?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Train that stops at regular stations.

lines.targetText: はい、大丈夫です。
lines.englishTranslation: Yes, that's fine.

lines.targetText: 片道で六百円です。
lines.englishTranslation: One way is 600 yen.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Used when stating the ticket type.

lines.targetText: カードで払えますか。
lines.englishTranslation: Can I pay by card?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Potential polite form of harau, to pay.

title: Talking About Weekend Plans
description: Two coworkers talk about plans for the weekend.

lines.targetText: 週末は何をしますか。
lines.pronunciationGuide: shuumatsu wa nani o shimasu ka.
lines.englishTranslation: What will you do this weekend?

lines.targetText: 友達と映画を見ます。
lines.englishTranslation: I'll watch a movie with a friend.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Marks someone you do something with.

lines.targetText: いいですね。どんな映画ですか。
lines.pronunciationGuide: ii desu ne. donna eiga desu ka.
lines.englishTranslation: Nice. What kind of movie is it?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Common adjective meaning good or nice.

lines.targetText: 新しいアニメ映画です。
lines.englishTranslation: It's a new anime movie.

lines.targetText: 楽しんでください。
lines.englishTranslation: Have fun.

title: Missing the Last Train
description: Two friends decide what to do after missing the last train.

lines.targetText: あ、終電がもう行きました。
lines.englishTranslation: Oh, the last train has already left.

vocabularyItems.explanation: The final train of the day.

lines.targetText: 本当ですか。どうしましょう。
lines.englishTranslation: Really? What should we do?

vocabularyItems.explanation: Polite phrase for considering what action to take.

lines.targetText: タクシーで帰りますか。
lines.englishTranslation: Shall we go home by taxi?

lines.targetText: 少し高いですね。近くのホテルを見ましょう。
lines.pronunciationGuide: sukoshi takai desu ne. chikaku no hoteru o mimashou.
lines.englishTranslation: That's a bit expensive. Let's look for a nearby hotel.

lines.targetText: そうですね。今、スマホで調べます。
lines.pronunciationGuide: sou desu ne. ima, sumaho de shirabemasu.
lines.englishTranslation: Good idea. I'll check on my phone now.

vocabularyItems.explanation: Common phrase for agreement or thinking.
